title: PHLDA1 is a shared diagnostic and key mediator of inflammatory fibrosis in heart and kidney.
authors: Hua, Lei; Shen, Liangru; Tao, Yongshou; Wang, Chentong; Shao, Xiaohang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PHLDA1在心脏和肾脏炎症纤维化中的共享机制，属于疾病病理与细胞互作研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inflammation-driven fibrosis represents a common pathological endpoint in both heart failure (HF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD), which together affect over 1 billion people worldwide. Understanding the shared molecular mechanisms by which inflammation contributes to the pathogenesis of HF and CKD is crucial for enabling early diagnosis and guiding the development of broad-spectrum therapeutic strategies. METHODS: Utilizing multi-omics technologies and machine learning algorithms, we performed an integrative analysis of HF and CKD samples to uncover shared mechanisms underlying inflammation-induced fibrosis. Furthermore, key regulators identified through bioinformatic analysis were experimentally validated using primary cell co-culture assays, gene knockout approaches, and bulk RNA sequencing. RESULTS: Single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) revealed concurrent upregulation of IL-1beta and Pleckstrin Homology-Like Domain Family A Member 1 (PHLDA1) in both cardiac M1 macrophages and injured proximal tubular epithelial (PTE) cells. PHLDA1 promotes IL-1beta expression and the knockout of PHLDA1 suppressed NF-kappaB signaling and renal fibrosis. Administration of IL-1beta induced PHLDA1 expression in cardiac fibroblasts and renal PDGFRbeta(+) cells, suggesting a positive feedback loop that contributes to fibrosis. CONCLUSIONS: In this study, we identified PHLDA1 as a key driver of fibrosis in both the heart and kidney, acting through IL-1beta mediated intercellular crosstalk. These findings indicate PHLDA1 as a potential therapeutic candidate for mitigating fibrosis in cardio-renal syndrome.
abstract_zh: 背景：炎症驱动的纤维化是心力衰竭（HF）和慢性肾脏病（CKD）共同的病理终点，这两种疾病全球影响超过10亿人。理解炎症促进HF和CKD发病机制的共享分子机制，对于实现早期诊断和指导广谱治疗策略的开发至关重要。方法：利用多组学技术和机器学习算法，我们对HF和CKD样本进行了整合分析，以揭示炎症诱导纤维化的共享机制。此外，通过生物信息学分析识别的关键调控因子，使用原代细胞共培养实验、基因敲除方法和批量RNA测序进行了实验验证。结果：单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）显示，在心脏M1巨噬细胞和受损近端肾小管上皮（PTE）细胞中，IL-1beta和Pleckstrin同源样结构域家族A成员1（PHLDA1）同时上调。PHLDA1促进IL-1beta表达，且PHLDA1的敲除抑制了NF-kappaB信号通路和肾纤维化。IL-1beta的给药诱导了心脏成纤维细胞和肾脏PDGFRbeta(+)细胞中PHLDA1的表达，提示存在一个促进纤维化的正反馈回路。结论：在本研究中，我们识别出PHLDA1作为心脏和肾脏纤维化的关键驱动因子，通过IL-1beta介导的细胞间串扰发挥作用。这些发现表明，PHLDA1是缓解心肾综合征纤维化的潜在治疗靶点。
